title: Consider These Things Before Hiring a Temporary Employee on Full Time
description: Before hiring temp staff full-time, know what to consider. Learn the pros, cons, and legal factors in UAE’s staffing process.

breadcrumb.name: Consider These Things Before Hiring a Temporary Employee on Full Time

contentHtml:
Growing businesses can benefit from temporary employment in lots of ways. These provisional workers add new efforts to improve efficiency. However, there are a few things to consider. Before contacting a temp agency, you must know your staffing needs and other things. By doing this, you will achieve better results.

In this article, we talk about different business needs and how to address them with provisional workers. Also, you will understand more about provisional staff and its benefits. We will also address the expenditures related to hiring this service. Our focus is to share with you all the opportunities that come with temporary employment.

  1. Why would you hire a temporary worker?
  2. What are your staffing needs?
  3. What are the differences between hiring temporary and permanent employees?
  4. Why are businesses looking for temporary staff?
  5. What are the costs associated with temporary employment?
  6. How can temporary workers support your business?
  7. What are the downsides of hiring people on a provisional basis?
  8. How could you hire temporary employees near you?

1. Why would you hire a temporary worker?

Many companies are suffering from understaffing issues. Due to our economic context, recruiters face difficulties hiring new people. Also, increasing taxes and inflation make it harder to find workers for your business. These factors complicate HR’s efforts to find an adequate option.

Additionally, busy seasons like holidays increase the demand for staff. During those dates, more companies hire people in huge amounts. To cover the soaring demand, companies hire provisional workers. More customers mean more stress and less productivity. Thus, to avoid overwhelming their staff, they hire people for a limited time.

Other reasons to hire temporary employment services include lowering costs in recruitment. Companies struggle to take on new workers. Elaborating long campaigns along with paying to recruiters represent elevated costs. Also, it takes a lot of time to come to fruition. Consequently, businesses outsource staffing needs to temp agencies.

Considering the aforementioned, you have plenty of reasons to hire temporary workers. Nonetheless, there are several things to take into account. By understanding them, you will succeed in your search for temp staff. Some factors such as your staffing needs can make pricing vary. It is worth taking a look deeper into these elements.

2. What are your staffing needs?

Every company has different needs. Although you can compare similarities, your business is quite distinct from others. Even if both organizations share the same niche. Consequently, to know how many people you need to hire, you must understand your business needs.

There are many things to ask yourself regarding your staffing needs. The first one is about the situation. How much demand are you facing? How are your current employees dealing with it? Evaluate your ongoing and previous performance in the same scenario. Know how well you performed under different types of pressure. This will give a hint about the number of temp workers needed.

Although you might think that hiring more yields better results, it depends on your possibilities. Bigger companies will have more capacity to hire new employees. However, smaller organizations have fewer resources. Thus, their plans should focus on hiring less. Yet, think that hiring depends on quality rather than quantity.

Finally, consider the positions you are trying to fill. Some jobs call for people available during long shifts. Others allow part-time workers or reduced turns. Depending on the time worked, prices may vary. Additionally, recruitment temporary employment companies can have different offerings. Assess different options and choose the one that suits you better.

3. What are the differences between hiring temporary and permanent employees?

Despite you might think that all employees are the same, the reality is different. Temporary and permanent employees exist to satisfy different needs. Each type represents different costs and sets of skills. Moreover, they yield diverse results according to the situation. Hence, to hire the most fitting option, you should distinguish their benefits and downsides.

Permanent staff is any kind of worker with a contract for an indefinite duration. This group also includes people whose deal continues to 12 months or more. They are regular employees offering their services to a company. Also, the contracting company pays directly to them and covers insurance, taxes, and other additional expenditures.

Contrarily, temp staff includes people hired for less than 12 months. Reasons to enroll them include seasonal, temporary, or fixed contracts. This array involves people hired by the same company or by an employment service.  Businesses tend to hire a temp agency because it will take care of additional payments regarding personnel.

Taking these things into account, we can see several differences. The main one is the duration of the contract. Temp staff stands out if you look to hire people on a provisional basis. They will support your business during that precise period. However, permanent workers are more useful if you look to fill positions in the long term. Yet, we will explain how recruiting provisional staff can get you closer to your objectives.

4. Why are businesses looking for temporary staff?

There are several benefits associated with hiring contract workers for a limited period. An increasing number of organizations look for temp manpower to fill positions. This happens because people are more aware of how those workers improve a business. Consequently, you can also include them in your efforts to enhance production.

Temporary staff is well known for their capacity. Temp staffing agencies recruit professionals in multiple niches to fulfill the demand. After enrollment, they make sure to train them to adapt swifter. This ensures that they will satisfy their clients’ needs. Also, they can impact the workplace by bringing new knowledge and technologies.

Hiring provisional personnel can yield you profits. Consider all the payments you have to make due to permanent workers. Include on that lists all taxes, insurance, and healthcare receipts. Those expenses make it hard to maneuver during busy seasons. Nonetheless, if you hire a manpower temp service, it will take care of those annoying charges for you.

In addition, businesses look for temporary employment services near them to recruit quickly. Enrolling new employees will take a lot of time if doing on your own. However, staffing firms already have tons of options to choose from. Their pools of personnel allow the firm to offer candidates in no time. This decreases the time needed to hire new people.

5. What are the costs associated with temporary employment?

After considering your staffing needs, you can assess costs easier. The price of recruiting temporary workers can vary according to your request. Something to consider beforehand is the number of workers. More people implies more payments. Also, the duration of the contract has a huge impact on the final price.

Before anything, costs depend on the staffing agency. As in any other service, you can find different ranges of prices and offerings. However, to estimate some costs, bear in mind that agencies charge a percentage over the hourly rate. These percentages range between 25 and 50%. Also, they can charge you if you want to permanently enroll a worker into your files.

Although the percentages might seem high, consider how much you lose with empty positions. The problem here is the lack of personnel. Companies sometimes refrain from hiring temp staff due to prices. Nonetheless, they fail to take into account the number of customers and sales lost to understaffing.

If you are aware of the potential losses, you know that hiring temp manpower outweighs any possible downsides. This happens because having more employees can increase productivity. Especially if your business faces hard times. Besides, they will help you to handle the overwhelming demand. As a result, your company will improve its quality of services.

6. How can temporary workers support your business?

If you hire temporary staff, you will see results quickly. When companies get this kind of worker in their files, they usually report increased productivity. The main benefit of employing temp staff is better services and products. Understaffed businesses tend to work in poorer conditions than those that have enough staff.

Also, you pay less for these workers compared to directly hiring workers. If you make a contract with a person, your company is responsible for additional expenditures. However, temp staffing agencies save you a lot of money. You will only have to pay the firm while they cover taxes and insurance. You will only have to pay the firm while they cover taxes and insurance.

Another point in favor of temporary employment services is flexibility. While you outsource your staffing needs, you can focus on more urgent matters. The staffing agency takes your worries for more manpower away. Consequently, you will have more free time to manage your business. This allows you to manage the company more efficiently.

Finally, if you are looking forward to expanding your business, the business will need more helping hands. Hence, temporary workers provide excellent support. They are professionals that can help you achieve your goals. In that sense, additional staff accelerates the achievement of objectives. So, they will take your organization to a new level.

7. What are the downsides of hiring people on a provisional basis?

Some organizations remain reluctant to hire temporary staff. Their managers usually think that this kind of worker will decrease quality. Because they do not share the company’s values, people often overlook them. Consider that newcomers need time to understand the business and its function. As a result, quality suffers during the adjustment period.

Also, people argue that outsiders require special training to adapt themselves. People think this way because they believe that temp workers need help to understand the context. Although this might be true in some cases, most provisional staff has preparation in that sense. Consequently, the majority of them can adapt easier than expected.

Take into consideration that these workers stay with you for a limited time. They depend on the contract achieved between you and the agency. Thus, direct hiring might not be an option if you liked the person. However, some temp employment services allow clients to hire permanently a worker for an additional quota.

Like everything, hiring people on a temporary basis comes with its drawbacks. Nonetheless, the benefits outweigh the flaws. The most important things to consider are your business needs. You are the one that decides if this option is the better for you. Remember to get advice to improve your results.
